summary: ReNew Energy Global plc furnished a Form 6-K on November 2, 2026, attaching Exhibit 99.1, its earnings release for Q2 FY27 and H1 FY27 ended September 30, 2026. The filing discloses operating and financial results only: portfolio of ~20.5 GW including 1.7 GW/6.2 GWh BESS, commissioned capacity up 19.5% YoY to ~13.7 GW, H1 FY27 total income of INR 97,483 million (US$1,017 million) and net profit of INR 12,375 million (US$129 million). No transaction, stake, price per share, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics are stated; it is a routine periodic results filing, not a special situation. Watch subsequent disclosures for any strategic or capital-markets actions.
